ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity with a global ratio of approximately 3:1 dark to light pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The right lobe features a large, contiguous high-intensity (white) region containing irregular low-intensity (black) linear streaks. The left lobe is primarily low-intensity black with sparse high-intensity linear marks. Both distal tips exhibit high-intensity beige/white circular pixel clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 55-degree V-shaped indentation; the vertex is partially obscured by high-intensity water spray pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous sequence of irregular, high-frequency triangular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 25 pixels along the trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory curving upwards and outwards from the central notch, tapering at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast, textured pixel groups (3-12 pixel diameter) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-intensity diagonal linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible on the right lobe; several horizontal and vertical linear marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the distal margins of both lobes; prominent linear rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical low-intensity (black) streak anomaly located on the inner upper quadrant of the left lobe.
